messages.author: caabb7cb6cc5f670
messages.subject: gheatmap error
parts:
Hi all,
When I use the gheatmap of ggtree to present the year annotation，the heatmap could be present the heatmap  and just the “Year” title. I had checked my data format and code， and couldn't solve this problem. Could anyone solve this problem？ Many thanks in advace.
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(Biostrings)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
tree <- read.tree("gp5new.nwk")
data <- read.table("11.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE,check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactor=F)
p <- ggtree(tree)
p1<-gheatmap(p, data[,3,drop=FALSE], offset =0.1, width=0.1, font.size=8,low = "green", high = "red", color = "white")
p1
